input.summary: Default Materials to Type I (Customer-owned) and confirm Customer ownership of Content
input.comment: [Playbook] We flip the default so that Materials created for us during the Service performance period are Type I (owned by us) rather than Type II, and we confirm that we retain ownership of our Content; our playbook requires that we own the deliverables we pay for and all data we put in, with IBM keeping its pre-existing IP. If IBM prefers, we can instead keep the Type II default provided the Type II licence is expanded to a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free right to use, modify and sublicense the Materials for our business.

ops.oldText: If not specified, Materials will be considered Type II Materials.
ops.newText: If not specified, Materials will be considered Type I Materials.

ops.text: e. As between the parties, Customer retains all right, title and interest (including all intellectual property rights) in and to the Content and the Customer Components. Nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers to IBM any ownership of the Content, the Customer Components or any Type I Materials, and no Materials will be jointly owned.
